117:     def test_matmul_acc_pipelined(self):
118:         """``tile.matmul_acc`` with the same 16×64 @ 2048 BF16 shape rewrites
119:         into a uniform K-loop: every iteration is ``tile.matmul_acc``, with
120:         the iter-arg init = caller's ``acc_init`` (no Vec placeholder, no
121:         if-else branch since the accumulator chain is uniform from the
122:         first iteration)."""
123: 
124:         @pl.program

11: Compiler-driven L0 matmul tiling (AutoTileMatmulL0) -- the placement x K-strategy matrix.
12: 
13: When a matmul's ``[M, N]`` output exceeds the cube accumulator L0c (128 KB on Ascend910B),
14: AutoTileMatmulL0 tiles the output into ``[m, n]`` sub-tiles and **places** each one by where
15: the result is consumed:
16: 
17:   - **DDR (direct-store)** -- the result is stored to a DDR tensor; each sub-tile is stored
18:     straight to ``out[mi:, ni:]``.
19:   - **Mat/L1 (Mat-scratch)** -- the result is consumed on-chip by *another matmul*; each
20:     sub-tile is assembled (Acc->Mat ``tile.assemble``) into an L1/Mat scratch kept on-chip,
21:     so the chain never spills the intermediate to DDR.
22: 
23: Orthogonally, the K (reduction) dimension picks the **K-strategy**:
24: 
25:   - **full-K** -- the whole K fits L0a/L0b at once (``k == K``); the M/N grid is a pipelined
26:     nest with loop-variable offsets (BuildFullKPipelined).
27:   - **split-K** -- K spans >= 2 L0 blocks; each ``[m, n]`` sub-tile is its own pipelined
28:     K-loop (BuildSplitKGrid).
29: 
30: The first four kernels are the oversized 2x2 matrix. The K-strategy is **shape-driven**: for
31: an ``[M, N] = [256, 256]`` FP32 output the L0 chooser caps ``k = 32``, so ``K = 32`` fits L0
32: in one pass (full-K) while ``K = 128`` splits into 4 K-blocks (split-K). No manual tiling --
33: the compiler picks the path from the shapes and the consumer.
34: 
35: **Fits-L0c chained matmul (cast-fold).** When the chained ``[M, N]`` intermediate *fits* L0c
36: (no M/N tiling), the same Mat/L1 placement applies as a **single full-window** Acc->Mat
37: ``tile.assemble``: the autotiler folds the ``pl.cast(c, bf16)`` into one cube FIXPIPE
38: ``pto.tinsert``, so the downcast stays on the cube. Without the fold the standalone ``pl.cast``
39: lowers to a Vector ``pto.tcvt`` (a cube->vector->cube round-trip that overflows the Vec buffer
40: at ``[128, 128]``). The fold matches FIXPIPE's fixed narrowing exactly — it fires only for
41: ``mode="rint"`` (round-half-to-even); the cast default ``"round"`` (ties away) and the
42: directional modes keep the Vector cast. FIXPIPE narrows tie-even on **both** A2/A3 and A5
43: (the cube writeback rounding is arch-independent — only the scratch dtype differs: A2/A3
44: forces bf16, A5 may keep f32), so the folded cast needs ``mode="rint"`` on either backend.
45: The last two kernels are the full-K (no K-loop) and split-K (K-loop) fits-L0c cases.
46: 
47: Run:  python examples/kernels/11_auto_tile_matmul.py
48: """
